summary: Normalise the support point into the box; then induction on j, each floor contributing floorModulus(F, a, p_a⁻¹) through lintegral_heisenbergMeasure_le with the unit (−p_a*)⁻¹.

steps.claim: ∫ … d(ascConv(η, j) ∗ ρ) = ∫_y ∫_ν Φ(νy)·invWeight(F, j, x)(w_j(p)νy) dascConv(η, j)(ν) dρ(y); compare the inner integrals for each y.

steps.lean:
rw [lintegral_congr_of_ae_imp ae_ascConv_mem_unipotentBelow fun ν
    e ↦ by rw [k.1 ν (unipotentBelow_le_unitriGroup e)], lintegral_const_mul]
steps.claim: Φ(νy) = Φ(y) for ν ∈ 𝒩_{<j} ⊂ Q_b (k); pull Φ(y) out.

steps.lean: obtain z | ⟨_, hξ, hg⟩ := em' (F.IsNear b y); simp_all
steps.claim: If y is not near at b then Φ(y) = 0; otherwise ξy ∈ Bx_F for some ξ ∈ Q_b.

steps.lean: obtain ⟨γ, k, u, l, rfl⟩ := exists_floorGroup_mul_unipotentBelow (unitriGroup_anti n hξ); gcongr
steps.claim: ξ ∈ Q_b ⊂ Q_j: write ξ = γu with γ ∈ H_j, u ∈ 𝒩_{<j}.

steps.lean:
grw [← (ascConv_heisenbergMeasure_invariant l).1, lintegral_mconv_dirac,
    lintegral_eq_of_dirac_mconv_eq (ascConv_heisenbergMeasure_dirac_comm _ k), globalConst,
    pow_three, ← Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hj.step]
steps.claim: Translate ν by u and move γ across (invariance and commutation of ascConv(η, j)); unfold globalConst = Λ_Γ^{10⁶(ϱ+1)³} and enlarge it using j ≤ ϱ < ϱ + 1.

steps.lean: refine j.rec (by simp [invWeight, floorWeight]) (fun a ih hj hp ↦ ?_) hj hp
steps.claim: Induction on j (the head condition restricts to shorter lengths); j = 0 is trivial.

steps.lean: lift a to Fin 𝔰.ϱ using hj
steps.claim: a < ϱ: regard a as a pair index.

steps.lean:
grw [ascConv_heisenbergMeasure_succ, lintegral_mconv_symm, Finset.prod_range_succ, pow_succ,
    mul_mul_mul_comm, ← ih _ (hp · ·.step), ← lintegral_mul_const,
    lintegral_le_of_ae_imp ae_ascConv_mem_unipotentBelow fun ν l ↦ ?_]
steps.claim: Split ascConv(η, a+1) = η_a ∗ ascConv(η, a), the factor a of the product and one power; apply the induction hypothesis to the inner integral; it remains to bound, for fixed ν ∈ 𝒩_{<a}, the integral over η_a.

steps.lean:
refine (Γ.com _ hg x o (ν.1.1 * F.orthonormalPart).toRows₁).elim fun φ ⟨_, h, e⟩ ↦
    lintegral_heisenbergMeasure_le (-star p a)⁻¹
    (setLIntegral_orthonormalPart_le hasFibreBound_floorVolume (e _)) fun t n ↦ ⟨⟨_, inv_mem l,
    (head_entries_mem_ofSize Γ.hasMatSize_box a.2 (by simpa [IsNear, invWeight] using
    n) ⟨inv_mem (mul_mem (unipotentBelow_le_unitriGroup (heisenbergElem_mem_floorUnipotent a t).2)
    (unipotentBelow_le_unitriGroup l)), by simpa using hg⟩ hp.star_head .refl).elim fun L k
    i ↦ by simpa [Γ.neg_star_mem_ofSize] using
    Γ.mul_mem_ofSize L (sub_mem_ofSize (k.2 i) (HasMatSize.one ..))⟩, ?_⟩
steps.claim: With φ from the field com (box point ξy, position x, v = the rows of νO), apply lintegral_heisenbergMeasure_le with the unit (−p_a*)⁻¹ and Ψ = φ(O_FᴴJ_T·)^{s_F} (setLIntegral_orthonormalPart_le, hasFibreBound_floorVolume): the size condition comes from head_entries_mem_ofSize for the head p* (the column of (ν(t)ν)⁻¹… at e*_a has size 10(ϱ+1)); the pointwise bound is left open (steps 11–15).
Pointwise: invWeight(F, a+1, x)(w_{a+1}(p)ν(t)νγy) ≤ floorWeight(F, a+1, ·, x)⁻¹ = floorWeight(F, a, ·, x)⁻¹·vol(floorValues(F, a, ·, x))^{−s_F} ≤ … φ(u)^{s_F} by the com bound ((h _).1).

steps.lean:
show invWeight .. = (floorWeight ..)⁻¹ from ite_eq_left
      ((mem_of_indicator_ne_zero n).imp (by grind))]; gcongr
steps.claim: On the support of the indicator, invWeight(F, a, x)(·) = floorWeight(F, a, ·, x)⁻¹.
Simplify the Weyl elements (w_{a+1}(p) = floor-a Weyl element times w_a(p), commuting with H_a) and the membership of the Heisenberg element in 𝒩_a.
Inclusion of the com set in the floor values: take u ∈ W (k: v·u = 0, c: close pairs).

steps.lean:
use (weylElem a.succ p * (P.heisenbergElem a t * ν)).1.1 *ᵥ F.orthonormalPart *ᵥ u,
    ⟨by simpa using c, ?_⟩ <;> simp [-mulVec_add, ← mulVec_mulVec, -fromRows_mulVec, funext (g :=
    F.orthonormalPart *ᵥ u) (Sum.rec (by simpa [↓mulVec_mulVec] using! (congrFun k)) fun i ↦
    unipotentBelow_mulVec_apply l (by simp) _ (by
      revert i; simp [level]; lia))] <;> simp [mulVec_apply_eq_sum, weylElem, weylOn, level]; lia
steps.claim: The witness w = (w_{a+1}(p)·ν(t)·ν)·O·u: its coordinates e*_b (b < a) vanish and the close-pair condition holds (unipotentBelow_mulVec_apply and the formula for the Weyl element), so its e*_a-coordinate lies in floorValues.
